_note: Brand-new party launched 2026-08-25 by תא"ל (מיל') עופר וינטר. Genuinely different from every other 'no official platform' party in this dataset (likud/shas/yahadut-hatorah/raam) — those have decades of coalition history, IDI analysis, and public record to draw on; this party has three weeks of a recruitment landing page and no other public record at all. Polling above threshold (~4 mandates) in most post-list-closing polls, explicitly self-identifies with 'מחנה הימין... ממשלת ימין רחבה' (the Netanyahu bloc), which is the only concrete signal used for the lib/questions.ts score estimate — user approved a rough right-bloc-lane estimate across all 9 topics (2026-09-16), security leaning closer to Otzma/Religious Zionism (Winter's military background + explicit bloc alignment), other topics closer to Likud/Beitenu's more moderate right lane, since no specific commitments exist to justify a sharper estimate anywhere. This is below even this file's own usual 'rough estimate, not verified' bar — re-check once the party publishes actual policy content or gives substantive interviews. See docs/sources/amcha-yisrael/2026-09-16-launch-coverage.md for full reasoning.

security._note: היחיד ה'ציטוט' הזמין כרגע — הצהרת מיצוב גושי כללית, לא עמדת מדיניות ביטחונית קונקרטית. וינטר עצמו מפקד צבאי בכיר לשעבר (חטיבת גבעתי), ידוע במיוחד ב'מכתב הפקודה' הדתי-לאומי השנוי במחלוקת ממלחמת עזה 2014 — נתון זיהוי, לא עמדת מדיניות מצוטטת.
